sources.title: Super audit API-FOOTBALL v3.9.3 (MP-API-FOOTBALL-V3-GLOBAL-AUDIT-01)
sources.acquisition: Public GitHub issue page, read-only, no credentials.
sources.provides: Endpoint paths only: 38 GET endpoints + /status, grouped in 5 families. The issue itself does not contain parameter contracts.

Parameter NAMES for /fixtures, /fixtures/statistics, /predictions, /odds, /teams/statistics and /odds/live from an earlier owner reading of the official documentation. Required-ness, types, allowed values and combinations must be re-verified.
Official endpoints, methods, parameters, types, constraints, examples, response structures, errors and pagination.
